test_cases.test_case: Successful login with valid credentials
test_cases.expected_result: authenticates and redirects to Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Username field blank
steps: 2. Enter <valid password> in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Username field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Password field blank
steps: 1. Enter <valid username> in the Username field
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Password field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Submit with both fields empty
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Username field indicating it is required; Inline validation error appears on the Password field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Enter invalid credentials
steps: 1. Enter <invalid username> in the Username field
2. Enter <invalid password> in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Error shown: 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service.'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt login with locked out user
steps: 1. Enter locked_out_user in the Username field
2. Enter secret_sauce in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Error shown: 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.'

test_cases.test_case: Enter a very long username
steps: 1. Enter a string of 200+ characters in the Username field
test_cases.expected_result: Error message displayed indicating that the username is invalid or trimmed to maximum length.

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters in the Username field
test_cases.expected_result: Error message displayed indicating that the username is invalid.

test_cases.test_case: Enter leading and trailing whitespace in the Username field
steps: 1. Enter '   standard_user   ' in the Username field
test_cases.expected_result: Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed; user is redirected to the Product Inventory page.

test_cases.test_case: Enter zero-length password
test_cases.expected_result: Error message displayed: 'Epic sadface: Password is required.'

test_cases.test_case: View product details
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: Product Detail page is displayed with the selected product's information

test_cases.test_case: Add product to cart
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Inventory page
2. Click 'Add to cart' on a product
test_cases.expected_result: The button changes to 'Remove' and the cart badge count updates accordingly

test_cases.test_case: Remove product from cart
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: The button changes back to 'Add to cart' and the cart badge count updates accordingly

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by name (A–Z)
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: Products are sorted in alphabetical order from A to Z

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by price (low–high)
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: Products are sorted in ascending order by price

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Product Name field blank and submit
steps: 1. Leave the Product Name field blank
2. Fill the Price field with a valid number
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Product Name field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Price field blank and submit
steps: 1. Fill the Product Name field with a valid name
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Price field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Enter a non-numeric value in the Price field
steps: 1. Fill the Product Name field with a valid name
2. Enter <non-numeric value> in the Price field
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Price field indicating it must be a number

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to remove an item that is not in the cart
steps: 1. Click Remove on a product that is not in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: No action occurs; the item remains unchanged in the cart

test_cases.test_case: Enter a valid price of 0 in the Price field
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; entity is created with the price of 0

test_cases.test_case: Enter a valid price of 1 in the Price field
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; entity is created with the price of 1

test_cases.test_case: Enter a very long product name
steps: 1. Enter a string of 200+ characters in the Product_Name field
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; product name is displayed correctly in the data table

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters in the Product_Name field
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; product name is displayed correctly in the data table

test_cases.test_case: Add product to cart
test_cases.expected_result: The cart state updates to reflect the added product

test_cases.test_case: Remove product from cart
preconditions: Product is already in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: The cart state updates to reflect the removed product

test_cases.test_case: Navigate back to products
test_cases.expected_result: Navigates to Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Navigate to shopping cart
test_cases.expected_result: Navigates to Shopping Cart

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to add a product to the cart when the product is out of stock
steps: 1. Click on the 'Add to cart' button
test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked; cart state remains unchanged; no product is added to the cart

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to navigate back to products
steps: 1. Click on the 'Back to products' button
test_cases.expected_result: Navigates to the Product Inventory page successfully

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to navigate to the shopping cart
test_cases.expected_result: Navigates to the Shopping Cart page successfully

test_cases.test_case: Rapidly click 'Add to cart' button twice
preconditions: User is on the Product Detail page
steps: 2. Immediately click the 'Add to cart' button again
test_cases.expected_result: 'Add to cart' button reflects the current cart state; no duplicate items are added to the cart

test_cases.test_case: Click 'Back to products' button after adding to cart
preconditions: User has clicked 'Add to cart' and the item is in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: User is navigated to the Product Inventory page; cart state remains unchanged

test_cases.test_case: Click 'Cart Icon' after adding an item to cart
preconditions: User has added an item to the cart
test_cases.expected_result: User is navigated to the Shopping Cart page showing the added item

test_cases.test_case: Remove an item from the cart
steps: 1. Click 'Remove' button for an item in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: The item is no longer visible in the cart

test_cases.test_case: Continue shopping from the cart
test_cases.expected_result: returns to Product Inventory

test_cases.test_case: Begin checkout from the cart
test_cases.expected_result: begins checkout

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to click 'Checkout' without any items in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: Checkout action is blocked; no transition occurs and the cart remains empty

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to click 'Remove' on an item when no items are present in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: Remove action is blocked; no items are removed and the cart remains empty

test_cases.test_case: Rapidly click 'Checkout' after adding an item
preconditions: At least one item is in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: 'Checkout' action succeeds; user is taken to the checkout page without errors.

test_cases.test_case: Click 'Continue Shopping' after adding an item
preconditions: At least one item is in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Product Inventory page without losing the cart state.

test_cases.test_case: Remove an item from the cart
preconditions: At least one item is in the cart
steps: 1. Click 'Remove' on the first item in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: The item is removed from the cart; the cart updates to reflect the change.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to remove an item when the cart is empty
steps: 1. Attempt to click 'Remove' on a non-existent item
test_cases.expected_result: No action is taken; a message indicates the cart is empty.

test_cases.test_case: Submit the checkout information form with valid data
steps: 1. Enter <valid first name> in the First Name field
2. Enter <valid last name> in the Last Name field
3. Enter <valid zip/postal code> in the Zip/Postal Code field
test_cases.expected_result: User proceeds to the overview step

test_cases.test_case: Cancel the checkout information form
test_cases.expected_result: User returns to the Shopping Cart

test_cases.test_case: Leave the First Name field blank and submit
steps: 1. Leave the First Name field blank
test_cases.expected_result: Error: First Name is required is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Last Name field blank and submit
steps: 2. Leave the Last Name field blank
test_cases.expected_result: Error: Last Name is required is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Zip/Postal Code field blank and submit
steps: 3. Leave the Zip/Postal Code field blank
test_cases.expected_result: Error: Postal Code is required is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Leave all required fields empty and submit
steps: 1. Leave the First Name field blank
2. Leave the Last Name field blank
3. Leave the Zip/Postal Code field blank
test_cases.expected_result: Error: First Name is required, Error: Last Name is required, Error: Postal Code is required are displayed

test_cases.test_case: Submit with First Name field empty
steps: 1. Leave the First Name field empty
2. Fill in the Last Name field with a valid name
3. Fill in the Zip/Postal Code field with a valid code
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Error: First Name is required'

test_cases.test_case: Submit with Last Name field empty
steps: 1. Fill in the First Name field with a valid name
2. Leave the Last Name field empty
3. Fill in the Zip/Postal Code field with a valid code
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Error: Last Name is required'

test_cases.test_case: Submit with Zip/Postal Code field empty
steps: 1. Fill in the First Name field with a valid name
2. Fill in the Last Name field with a valid name
3. Leave the Zip/Postal Code field empty
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Error: Postal Code is required'

test_cases.test_case: Submit with long string in First Name
steps: 1. Enter a very long string in the First Name field (200+ characters)
2. Fill in the Last Name field with a valid name
3. Fill in the Zip/Postal Code field with a valid code
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; entity is created with the long First Name

test_cases.test_case: Submit with special characters in Last Name
steps: 1. Fill in the First Name field with a valid name
2. Enter special characters in the Last Name field
3. Fill in the Zip/Postal Code field with a valid code
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; entity is created with the special characters in Last Name

test_cases.test_case: Complete the order successfully
preconditions: Order items are present in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: completes the order and navigates to the confirmation page

test_cases.test_case: Cancel the checkout process
preconditions: Order items are present in the cart
test_cases.expected_result: exits checkout

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to finish checkout without any payment information
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; error shown indicating Payment Information is required

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to finish checkout without any shipping information
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; error shown indicating Shipping Information is required

test_cases.test_case: Click Cancel to exit checkout
test_cases.expected_result: Exits checkout without completing the order

test_cases.test_case: Enter a very long string in the Order Summary field
steps: 1. Enter a string of 200+ characters in the Order Summary field
test_cases.expected_result: Order Summary field accepts the input without error or truncation

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters in the Payment Information field
steps: 1. Enter special characters (e.g., @#$%^&*) in the Payment Information field
test_cases.expected_result: Payment Information field accepts the input without error

test_cases.test_case: Enter leading and trailing whitespace in the Shipping Information field
steps: 1. Enter '   Shipping Address   ' in the Shipping Information field
test_cases.expected_result: Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed; saved value shown has no extra spaces

test_cases.test_case: User returns to Product Inventory from Confirmation page
test_cases.expected_result: returns to Product Inventory and clears the cart

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to access the confirmation page without completing the checkout process
steps: 1. Navigate to the confirmation page directly
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page or an error message is displayed indicating that the checkout process is incomplete

test_cases.test_case: Rapid re-submission after redirect
preconditions: User has successfully submitted an order and is on the confirmation page.
steps: 2. Immediately press the browser back button.
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Product Inventory page; no duplicate order is created.

test_cases.test_case: User successfully logs out
test_cases.expected_result: ends the session and redirects to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to logout while not logged in
steps: 1. Attempt to click the Logout button
test_cases.expected_result: Logout action is blocked; user remains on the current page and is not redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive logout attempts
steps: 2. Immediately click the Logout button again
test_cases.expected_result: Second logout attempt is blocked; user remains on the login page without any session termination

test_cases.test_case: Logout after session timeout
preconditions: User was logged in, but session has timed out
test_cases.expected_result: Logout action is blocked; user remains on the current page with an error message indicating session timeout

test_cases.test_case: Reset app state successfully
test_cases.expected_result: clears cart and resets in-app state

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to reset app state without being logged in
steps: 1. Attempt to click the Reset App State Button
test_cases.expected_result: User is blocked from resetting app state; remains on the current page without any changes.

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive clicks on the Reset App State button
preconditions: User is logged in and has items in the cart
steps: 1. Click the Reset App State button
2. Immediately click the Reset App State button again
test_cases.expected_result: The app state resets successfully; the cart is cleared and the reset action is confirmed without errors.

test_cases.test_case: Click the Reset App State button after adding an item to the cart
preconditions: User is logged in and has added items to the cart
steps: 1. Add an item to the cart
2. Click the Reset App State button
test_cases.expected_result: The cart is cleared and the in-app state resets; the cart badge is updated to reflect the cleared state.
